title: Rollout ops sketch — Left of the Runway
content:
Purpose

Quick working sketch for a compact, cross-functional rollout play that lives left of the runway: low-friction steps product + eng + SRE can run before an official canary. Target audience: product owners, release stewards, oncall SREs, solutions eng.

Scope and goals

- Make small LLM-driven feature activations safer and faster with a 30–90m lightweight checklist.
- Give a playbook for microexposure (<=2% traffic) and an immediate escalation path if signals degrade.
- Define minimal telemetry, synthetic probes, and a default rollback surface.

Key assumptions

- Backend supports feature flagging + weighted traffic splits.
- Canary variant is a model/config change (new model, quantization, or prompt rewrite) not a full infra change.
- Teams can spin synthetic traffic and run deterministic sample queries.

Roles (quick)

- Release steward (owner): coordinates activation, communicates windows, hits rollback if needed (default: product PM).
- SRE oncall: watches latency/error SLOs, runs synthetic probe runner, initiates fail-open route if infra alarms fire.
- Observability engineer: ensures short-lived dashboards & alert rules are in place pre-activation.
- Solutions / SE: prepares representative prompt sets, smoke tests, and customer-impact mapping.

Activation checklist (30–90m)

1) Preflight (15–25m)
   - Create ephemeral metrics dashboard (latency p50/p95, error rate, token-cost rate, model confidence proxies).
   - Register one synthetic probe suite (10–30 synthetic queries covering common failure modes).
   - Confirm feature flag targeting and fallback variant exist (+ simple toggle to 100% fallback).
   - Post short note in #release-orchestra and tag steward + SRE oncall.

2) Microexposure ramp (10–30m)
   - Start at 0.1% traffic or one control user cohort.
   - Run synthetic probes every 30s and compare to baseline windows (last 24h).
   - Observe for anomalous drift (>3 sigma) in latency or error rate and content regressions (quality sandbox checks).
   - If no adverse signals after 10m, step to 1% for 10–20m.

3) Decision gates and heuristics
   - Blockers (immediate rollback): failure to meet p95 latency SLO degraded >30% OR error rate spike >0.5% absolute AND increasing.
   - Soft alerts (investigate): slight quality regressions on 3+ sample prompts OR token-cost increase >15% without latency benefit.
   - If any blocker fires, steward triggers rollback and posts incident-lite note.

Minimal telemetry spec (must be present)

- Latency p50/p95 per variant; request count.
- Token consumption per request (avg).
- Error count + class distribution (timeout, model error, infra).
- Synthetic probe pass rate and similarity score to golden answers.
- A/B quality snapshot: small set (n=20) of golden prompts with automated scoring.

Synthetic probe plan (concrete)

- 20 probes across edge cases: short answer, long-form, multi-turn, hallucination-prone prompt, reranker test.
- Run 1 probe every 30s per variant; log pass/fail and semantic similarity score.
- Store results to ephemeral dataset for quick comparison.

Communications & commands

- Slack template for steward to kick start: "Activating microexposure for feature X now: 0.1% -> 1% schedule, watching metrics @SRE, @Obs. Rollback on p95 latency +30% or errors +0.5%."
- Quick CLI to flip flag (example): rf flag set feature-x variant-b --weight 0.1

Rollback and postmortem minimal flow

- Immediate rollback: steward executes flag reset -> 100% fallback; SRE confirms route.
- Short postmortem within 24h: owner documents signal that tripped, root cause hypothesis, remediation action and next attempt gating checklist.

Open decisions / TODOs

- How to automate semantic-similarity thresholds across languages (Priya to prototype).
- Converge on default synthetic probe corpus (Jonah to seed with customer anonymized samples).
- Integrate with Console to auto-create ephemeral dashboards when steward starts a microexposure (product-ops follow-up).

Notes to self (cheap experiments)

- Try scripted microexposure for prompt-only changes (no model swap) to validate quality gating thresholds.
- Run a simulated degraded infra scenario in staging: synthetic probe failing but latency ok -> test human review cadence.

References and artifacts

- JIRA-4528 (feature flag rollout epic), GH-PR-9983 (telemetry dashboard helper), confluence://rollouts/activation-templates

End of sketch — aims to be a small, replicable pattern teams can adapt. This doc is deliberately short and runnable; please paste additions below or update linked artifacts.
